# `accounts.current_account.AccountOpened`

The demand account (conta à ordem) is opened and starts transacting ([ADR-PC-037](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-037-current-account-family.md): Pending -> Active). Carries the structural product identity fixed at opening; the account's balances are NOT here — both the accounting and available balances are spine-owned folds over the movement ledger + hold set ([ADR-PC-033](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-033-account-abstraction-and-hold-lifecycle.md)), never a stored number. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — the account id is an opaque instance reference, never a name/NIF/IBAN. Account opening (KYC/onboarding) stays upstream ([ADR-PC-024](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-024-constitution-precondition-contract.md) / [ADR-PC-030](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-030-product-scope-and-boundary.md)).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | AccountId (Guid) — the account stream id, which is also this account's opaque account_ref. Never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `product_code` | `string` | The catalogue product code the account was opened under (e.g. ca_pt_standard) — the structural product identifier. NOT PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `currency` | `string` | The account's ISO-4217 currency (e.g. EUR) — a structural token. |
| `opened_on` | `int` (`date`) | OpenedOn (DateOnly) — the value-date the account opened, as days since epoch. An input date, never a clock read. |
